runners.comment: 3m6f on heavy too much for him last time; does enjoy some cut underfoot, however
runners.spotlight: Overall chase record of 2-16; dug deep to win over a trip just shy of 3m at Lingfield (soft; 5lb lower) and 3m6f on heavy found him out at Exeter a month ago; may prefer softer ground in an ideal world but hard to rule out.

quotes.race: Watch Unbridled On attheraces.com Handicap Chase
quotes.quote: Icaque De L'Isle wasn't helped when I dropped my stick! It's taken him a while to get his chasing together but he's a lot more mature now and is a little bit more straightforward. He stays well, has a good attitude and has always seemed to handle this softer ground well - Harry Bannister, jockey, speaking to Sky Sports Racing.

runners.comment: Has the form to feature off this mark and won't mind getting back on drier ground
runners.spotlight: Hasn't been at her best of late (behind Smurfette latest) but she has the form to feature off this mark and won't mind getting back on drier ground; stays this far; possible.

runners.comment: Won after a longer break in November and could leave his latest below-par run behind
runners.spotlight: Defied an even longer break at Hereford in November (3m1f, good) off only 1lb lower and his following run was just as good; could easily leave his latest below-par run behind.

quotes.race: BeatWright: Beat The Wright Way Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: I was very pleased with Copshill Lad. I think the key was his jumping. We thought about going chasing when he was beaten at Ascot last year, but we wanted to give him a full season afterwards. He's not the fastest, but he's very genuine and he kept on galloping. Hopefully chasing can bring out further improvement - Harry Derham, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: He runs in the famous colours of Middleham Park Racing and made a winning debut when landing a Stratford bumper in May. We have tinkered with his wind over the summer, and he is now back in full work. He should be ready to resume next month with a view to tackling National Hunt novice hurdles. 13-10-22

prev_owners.owner: Colm Donlon And Alne Park Stud

runners.comment: Consistent mare who made it 2-2 here when a narrow winner earlier this month
runners.spotlight: Consistent 8yo who made it 2-2 here when a narrow winner earlier this month; only raised 3lb and this willing mare should have every chance; has won on good.

racecards.verdict: On a good mark and perhaps best caught fresh, COPSHILL LAD is taken to return to winning ways.

runners.breeder: E A R L De Faydeau
runners.comment: Two good runs after wind surgery, especially last time when going down by only 2l
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced maiden; two good runs after wind surgery, especially last time when going down by only 2l at Plumpton (2m1f, soft); ran well in a bumper on this sort of ground.

runners.comment: Has been in good form over hurdles and fences; should be involved
runners.spotlight: Made a winning handicap/chasing debut at Kelso in November (2m1f, soft) and was then second of four on good ground; it was heavy when he pulled up and then, with a hood replaced by cheekpieces, he got back on track with another second over hurdles at this track; should be involved.

runners.owner: K Jardine R Griffiths W Duffus

prev_owners.owner: K Jardine R Griffiths D Boyce W Duffus

runners.comment: Won on his chase/stable debut at Catterick and bumped into a big improver there next time
runners.spotlight: Won on his chase/stable debut at Catterick (by 4.5l; 1m7f, good to soft) and bumped into a big improver back there 20 days ago (on good); seriously considered off the same mark.

runners.comment: Poor form claims but performed below market expectations on recent yard debut
runners.spotlight: Can't make much of a case on his form but he is very lightly raced and was noticeably short in the betting (100-30) when well held on last week's stable debut at Ffos Las (2m3f, soft; second chase run); perhaps he'll enjoy this drier surface.

stable_tour.quote: He's very well and we were very disappointed with him at Newbury. We're not sure what went wrong, but we need him to do a bit better. 23-12-24

racecards.verdict: The 6yo SHADOWFAX OF ROHAN (nap) bumped into a sharp improver last time and he gets in here off the same mark.

runners.comment: Soft ground perhaps not ideal last time, and that was at Ascot; had wind op
runners.spotlight: Won a fast-ground Irish point by 18l; tongue tied for both his bumpers; a keeping-on third of 14 at Hereford (good) and has had wind surgery since finishing well beaten on soft at Ascot (behind Champion Bumper third Bass Hunter); of definite interest back at this level and on ground that he clearly handles.

runners.comment: Failed to complete in four Irish points but has joined a leading yard for rules action
runners.spotlight: Failed to complete in four Irish points, though was in contention when falling in the penultimate one; Olly Murphy clearly saw something he liked to have taken him on board.

runners.comment: Irish run reads well; tailed off at Warwick but was a strong 2-1 market leader
runners.spotlight: The form of his second on yielding to soft in Ireland worked out well and, although most disappointing on yard debut at Warwick (good to soft), he did go off the 2-1 favourite; interesting to see if supporters return.

runners.comment: Easy to back and tailed off in her first two bumpers, on good to soft and good
runners.spotlight: Easy to back and tailed off in her first two bumpers, on good to soft and good.

runners.comment: Excellent Flat pedigree as a Juddmonte-bred son of Kingman but sold on for 3,000gns
runners.spotlight: Excellent Flat pedigree as a Juddmonte-bred son of Kingman; however, he was sold for 3,000gns as a 3yo and can only be watched with no experience on the board.

runners.comment: 5-1 at Doncaster and only faded out of the picture late on (soft)
runners.spotlight: 5-1 at Doncaster and only faded out of the picture late on (soft); may approve of these drier conditions and stable is always respected in bumpers.

runners.comment: He was with Tom Weston when a 10l fourth on heavy ground at Wincanton
runners.spotlight: He was with Tom Weston (who runs Music Song) when a 10l fourth on heavy ground at Wincanton and those conditions weren't ideal for a newcomer; may improve.

runners.comment: Beaten 20l at Hereford but he was a short-priced favourite and the ground was soft
runners.spotlight: Folded late on and beaten about 20l on soft ground at Hereford; however, he did go off a short-priced favourite and encounters different conditions here.

racecards.verdict: David Pipe's INDULTO ROUGE has undergone a wind operation since finishing well beaten in a soft-ground Ascot bumper.

runners.comment: He was lucky to win his maiden 14 months ago and is now 0-5 in handicaps
runners.spotlight: He was lucky to win his maiden 14 months ago and is now 0-5 in handicaps after pulling up at Newcastle (2m7f, good to soft); others have more going for them.

runners.comment: Not progressing but this is his first handicap in a new tongue-tie
runners.spotlight: Hasn't really progressed as expected from his competitive bumper runs and pulled up in his latest maiden after hanging left handed around Hereford; this track may be more to his liking and this is his first handicap in a new tongue-tie.

stable_tour.quote: He's disappointed over hurdles so far and didn't get very far when brought down at the first at Fontwell on Thursday, but he's absolutely massive and I'm confident he'll make up into a nice novice handicap chaser this season. 24-10-25

runners.owner: R & W, The 8 Amigos, Burns, Austerfield
runners.comment: Tongue-tie on for handicap debut and would merit attention if at all strong in the betting
runners.spotlight: It's been a struggle in novice races but she now goes into a handicap with a tongue-tie fitted and over a much longer trip that could benefit according to her pedigree; would merit greater attention if at all strong in the betting.

runners.owner: C J Underwood And Caroline Fryer
runners.comment: Well beaten in two runs for current yard but this good ground will suit him better
runners.spotlight: Two wins last year for Olly Murphy and those were on good ground; beaten 28l and 26l in two runs for current yard, though conditions were soft and good to soft; better can be expected here, though all his notable form is at about 2m4f.

runners.owner: M White J Frampton L Horsfall

prev_owners.owner: M White C Voysey J Frampton L Horsfall

runners.comment: Had dropped to a good mark and finally exploited it with a head success at Hereford
runners.spotlight: Had dropped to a good mark and finally exploited it with a head success at Hereford (3m1f, good); that was a weak race but he's only 2lb higher and should give some less exposed rivals plenty to think about.

quotes.race: fairplaybet.co.uk Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Jack The Savage deserved that. He's a very consistent type - Laura Horsfall, trainer.

quotes.race: Discover Whats Trending At Rhino.Bet Casino Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: I love this horse, but he has had such bad luck. He ran his race before it started at Worcester as he bucked the jockey off twice then he was due to go to Fakenham, but that was abandoned then at Hereford he was withdrawn after he kicked Alex Edwards (jockey). Although he is called Jack The Savage he is anything but that as he is my hack at home every day and he is such a legend.

runners.comment: Placed in both handicaps; lightly raced so retains potential and he's up in trip
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; beaten 5l on handicap debut at Sedgefield (2m4f, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) but more than double that margin when behind an easy winner at Doncaster (2m3f; tongue-tie added); lightly raced so retains potential and he's up in trip.

stable_tour.quote: A lovely horse who is going to make a hell of a chaser. He had his first start over hurdles at Ayr last week and scoped dirty afterwards, so we didn't really learn anything. We'll build him back up and step him up in trip throughout the season. 20-11-25

He hasn't quite lived up to expectations yet. He still looks quite green and babyish. He's a chaser for next season but he'll have a couple more runs. We thought he'd win at Doncaster last month but the winner looked well handicapped and got away from him. Once he gets his head in front, he could win two or three on the bounce. He should be very well handicapped. 13-03-26

runners.comment: 0-18 under rules and very opposable on how he's performed in the last year
runners.spotlight: A long time since he showed his best form and very opposable on how he's performed in the last year, especially as he's out of the weights.

racecards.verdict: A chance is taken on handicap debutante REDEEMING LOVE who is up markedly in trip and her dam won over this far.

prev_owners.owner: Brian Groarke & Tom Groarke & Ms Margaret Mullins

runners.comment: Irish maiden hurdle winner who has been found a weak race to carry his penalty
runners.spotlight: Contested two maiden hurdles in Ireland and prevailed narrowly at Thurles (2m4f, yielding); that form has some substance and he later changed hands for £70,000; has been found a weak race to carry his penalty.

quotes.race: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction Maiden Hurdle (IRE Incentive)
quotes.quote: I am delighted with Hillberry Hill. An improving horse. He ran a lovely race first time at Clonmel, and I thought he would improve. He's a bit of a babby. I wasn't surprised that he won. I'd say he's a chaser in the making. Henry [de Bromhead] thinks a lot of his horse, so you'd have to be delighted with him. It's great for Brian [Groarke] and Tom [Groarke] and the whole team. I'd say he's a nice horse. We'll wait and see now and see how he comes out of it and make a plan from there - Mags Mullins, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: He was second in an Aintree bumper on his debut and beaten only six lengths in a Listed bumper at Cheltenham on New Year's Day. He was disappointing on his debut over hurdles, but he wasn't quite right when he came home. We'll give him a bit of time to recover and hopefully he can leave that run behind him. 18-11-25

runners.owner: Mrs I C Sellars And Miss D C Sellars
runners.comment: Also tongue tied in his bumper but he finished tailed off on good to soft at Chepstow
runners.spotlight: Also tongue tied in his bumper but he finished tailed off on good to soft at Chepstow; stable second string here by the looks.

runners.comment: All his wins have been over fences but he's back hurdling in a race with no depth
runners.spotlight: Six-time chase winner who won last summer but twice disappointed since; he's 0-8 as a hurdler but ability needs respecting when there's no depth to this race.

quotes.race: Associated British Ports 'Summer Plate Trial' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: The Flier Begley dug deep when I needed him to and thankfully he's a stayer. I was worried the rise in the handicap might catch him out, but he proved me wrong. He's been a revelation since last year. We've won some nice pots along the way and I think Gary [Hanmer, trainer] has found the key to him now, keeping him fresh and well. Some of these older horses enjoy being in a smaller yard. I think he'll have a good chance in that [Summer Plate on July 19], but it depends what the handicapper does. I said to the owners if I win today it will have to be by the smallest of margins! - Jack Hogan, jockey, speaking to Racing TV.

quotes.race: Unibet Middle Distance Veterans' Handicap Chase (Series Final)
quotes.quote: That was super. We were a little bit disappointed with The Flier Begley's last run and I think we might have gone to the well once too often so we backed off and freshened him up - Gavin Hanmer, trainer.

quotes.race: Unibet Middle Distance Chase Series Veterans' Handicap Chase (Unibet  Vets' Chase Series)
quotes.quote: The Flier Begley is a dream to ride, he travels and jumps like a buck. He won quite well in the end. He ran well last time at Haydock and before that he just didn't get home as he was too keen. He's in form now and seems to be showing it. I thought we were up against it with some of the horses here, but we were coming into it with a horse in form. He likes top of the ground and he stays well - Jack Hogan, jockey.

runners.comment: He was 150-1 when a remote fourth over C&D (soft) a month ago and is again up against it
runners.spotlight: He was 150-1 when a remote fourth over C&D (soft) a month ago and is again up against it.

runners.comment: Her best run was the first and opposable on subsequent exploits
runners.spotlight: Her best run was the first when beaten 8l in a Uttoxeter bumper; opposable on subsequent exploits.

racecards.verdict: It wasn't a bad maiden that HILLBERRY HILL won in Ireland and he's been found a very weak race to carry his penalty.
racecards.betting_forecast: 4/6 Hillberry Hill, 2/1 The Flier Begley, 11/1 Danger Nap, 14/1 Sea Of Fortune, 33/1 Tombereau,  Karlita Desbois

racecards.race_name: Join Southwell Golf Club Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Has been chasing; lower hurdle mark but without a win in this discipline since 2022
runners.spotlight: Good and bad since returned to fences (1P4); runs off a lower hurdles mark but he is a 10yo and without a win in this discipline since 2022.

quotes.race: Betfred Supports Jack Berry House Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Fine Casting ran a cracker last time at Doncaster on ground that was probably too quick for him. [It was] a good gallop on that ground as well today and he was on the right mark. He had the earplugs in today and was a bit asleep on me, but he came alive in the back straight - Kevin Brogan, winning rider.

quotes.race: Play 3-2-Win At MansionBet Standard Open National Hunt Flat Race (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: I'm very pleased with that. I think Fine Casting is very good and he'd be a horse for the Aintree bumper. He's probably a two-and-a-half miler who wants a proper gallop but the better bumpers are run at better paces - Ben Pauling, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: He had a couple of seasons over hurdles and was fourth in the Imperial Cup last season, but he could be miles better as a chaser - we schooled him over fences recently and he was electric. He loves soft ground. 10-11-23

We've always thought a lot of him and he won his bumper last season at Newbury in good style. He has run twice over hurdles this season, most recently at Uttoxeter where he jumped much better. He still needs to learn to relax but will win his novice soon and how far he will progress I do not know. I'd be disappointed if he did not turn out to be a decent handicap hurdler. 30-11-21

runners.comment: No closer than 13l in five runs for this yard, the last two over hurdles
runners.spotlight: Won a novice hurdle and two handicap chases for Alan King; no closer than 13l in five runs for this yard, the last two over hurdles; had a wind operation.

quotes.race: Nick Embiricos Memorial Handicap Chase
quotes.quote: I think Menaggio was very good. He was a bit long at the first ditch but on the whole I was delighted with his jumping and he saw it out well. I hadn't really looked beyond this race. We just wanted to get him started. We'll sit down and have a think but he's a nice prospect and he'll get further. I think he'd get three [miles] but we're not in a rush to get there. That was a sharp as he wants there. Hopefully, he's progressing - Alan King, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: He only won once over hurdles last season but his final second at Kempton was a good effort, probably his best run. He made a winning chase debut over 2m3½f at Plumpton on Monday, jumping really well and staying on powerfully. I hope he'll continue to progress, particularly over slightly further. 25-10-24

He was the first of my exciting team of novice chasers to win over fences and he did the job well at Plumpton, jumping soundly and staying on powerfully. He'd shown decent form as a hurdler and should continue to progress, particularly over slightly further than 2m4f. 07-11-24

runners.breeder: Kenneth L Ramsey & Sarah K Ramsey
runners.comment: Lost his way for previous yard; well beaten on the AW on first run for this one
runners.spotlight: Never got involved when eighth of 11 on his stable debut at Southwell (1m4f, Tapeta) a month ago; dual hurdle winner but didn't sign off for previous yard in much form, over hurdles or fences.

quotes.race: Jodie Standing's Point-To-Point Recruits Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Isle Of Sark showed a great attitude with the visor on for the first time today and it's made all the difference - Mickey Bowen, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: We were pleased with his run in the Ballysax, which was his first run on turf, and he will have learned a lot from that. He seems to have come out of that race well and he'll probably go for another Derby trial. 19-04-21

runners.breeder: Dr V Ana Sofia Dias Trindade & Tim Lane
runners.comment: Two wins in November; appeared to find soft ground against him when tailed off latest
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back wins at this sort of trip in November on good to soft; fell early when favourite next time and it was his first run on soft when tailed off at Huntingdon; on this ground and with cheekpieces added, he's one to consider.

stable_tour.quote: He ran well in all three of his bumpers and then we gave him some experience over hurdles on his final start at Newbury last season. Fourth on his comeback at Fontwell on Thursday, he'll be a nice novice hurdler over two and a half miles-plus. 24-10-25
He's a nice horse by Masterstroke. He was second on his debut in a bumper at Southwell in early December and runs at Huntingdon on Thursday in another bumper. 01-01-25

runners.comment: Failed to fire last time but had been runner-up in his three previous races
runners.spotlight: Failed to fire last time but had been runner-up in his three previous races and Danny McMenamin takes over from a 10lb claimer; this veteran isn't without hope as trip/ground will be fine.

quotes.race: Racing Post Go North Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Summergrounds is a consistent little horse and he loves this ground. Danny gave him a great ride, they were getting at it and he just took his time - Nicky Richards, trainer.

runners.comment: Placed on handicap debut at Newbury (2m) despite making some mistakes
runners.spotlight: Placed in a maiden here and again on handicap debut at Newbury (2m) despite making some mistakes; a combination of this longer trip and first-time headgear could help him in that respect; can go well.

stable_tour.quote: He had one run in a four-year-old bumper at Punchestown for Jamie Sloan, when inexperience showed, and then he was put away for the summer and sent to us. He's benefited from that break and has come in as a really strong individual. He'll almost certainly go straight over hurdles and it'll be interesting to see how far he goes. 22-10-24

runners.comment: Rallying third in new cheekpieces at Warwick (2m) and he now returns to further
runners.spotlight: His only win came over Fakenham's sharp 2m but his rallying third in first-time cheekpieces at Warwick last time (2m) suggested he probably needs further now; considered.

runners.comment: Arrives here in no form and the return to hurdles did nothing last time
runners.spotlight: Did well last season with three wins over fences but arrives here in no form and the return to hurdles did nothing last time.

quotes.race: Visit Huntingdon Racecourse For Your Conference Handicap Chase
quotes.quote: It was trainer error the last day. Heard That was just too keen stepping up to 3m and he missed fences like mad round Warwick which you just can't do. We dropped him back in trip and they went hard today which suited him. He's a horse who's hopefully progressing and I imagine we'll see him back over 3m in the spring - Olly Murphy, trainer, talking to Racing TV.

runners.comment: No match for the winner in his last two races over hurdles but both were well handicapped
runners.spotlight: No match for the winner in his last two races over hurdles but both were well handicapped and returning to a longer trip looks the right move; on the shortlist.

runners.comment: His final maiden run reads well; pulled up on handicap debut but has had a wind op
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner; only 13l off the Supreme fourth Baron Noir in a Uttoxeter maiden before finishing tailed off on his handicap debut (both those runs on soft and in a new tongue-tie); could be interesting on the back of a wind operation.

runners.comment: Course maiden winner; twice placed in handicaps but looks a tad high in the ratings
runners.spotlight: Won his maiden here 13 months ago when making all; twice placed in four subsequent handicaps but does look a tad high in the ratings.

quotes.race: Grace And Dotty Fedora's And Feathers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div I)
quotes.quote: Karton Plein is a nice horse who ran well in a stronger race than this last week and he'll be a lovely chaser down the line - Olly Murphy, trainer, speaking to Sky Sports Racing.

racecards.verdict: This looks open. MOAB has finished second to well-handicapped horses in his last two hurdle races and the return to further can help.
racecards.betting_forecast: 9/2 Codetalker, 5/1 Moab,  Karton Plein, 6/1 Fine Casting,  Sutherland, 7/1 Nazare, 10/1 Summergrounds, 11/1 Menaggio, 14/1 Purple Owl, 25/1 Isle Of Sark,  Heard That

racecards.race_name: Visit The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Beaten 14l off this mark last time but a subsequent wind operation could help
runners.spotlight: Looked a non-stayer over 2m7f on his handicap debut but was beaten even further back over 2m4f at Market Rasen (14l off the winner); off the same mark here but has undergone a wind operation, which may help.

runners.comment: Latest fifth in a Bangor maiden for mares was her best run yet under rules
runners.spotlight: Latest fifth in a Bangor maiden for mares was her best run yet under rules and gives her some momentum ahead of this handicap debut; did show plenty of promise in Irish points.

runners.comment: Best run was here on soft ground; appeared to get outpaced last time on a good surface
runners.spotlight: No wins in nine; best run was here on her penultimate start when going down narrowly over this trip on soft ground; appeared to get outpaced on good ground at Huntingdon 13 days ago so that's a worry.

runners.comment: Second here in December but hard to trust after two heavier defeats
runners.spotlight: Beaten a length over C&D (good to soft) in December but hard to trust after two heavier defeats (first-time tongue-tie last time); bit risky.

runners.comment: Capable chaser (three-time winner) but his hurdle form is not so convincing
runners.spotlight: Has only won over fences (three times) and still held some sort of chance when unseating nine days ago at Market Rasen; his hurdle form isn't so convincing, though.

runners.owner: DL Adams, JA Adams & G McPherson
runners.comment: Lightly raced but makes handicap debut after wind surgery and a long absence
runners.spotlight: Forgettable efforts in his qualifying races (2m4f/2m5f) and makes handicap debut after wind surgery and a long absence; would need to see some confidence behind him.

runners.comment: Soft ground to blame when raised in trip on handicap debut; can be given another chance
runners.spotlight: Struggled in novice races over shorter and was expected to improve for 2m5f on handicap debut only to find soft ground against him; remains unexposed and wears a first-time tongue-tie; could easily have a major say.

runners.comment: Won his final chase start by some 20l and only 4lb higher for this return to hurdling
runners.spotlight: None too consistent but he made it 4-12 over fences when scoring by 20l at Doncaster (2m3f, good; was left clear late on) and he's only 4lb higher for this return to hurdles; still comes with risks given overall profile and he's 0-9 in this discipline.

stable_tour.quote: He's been amazing because he's had two tendon injuries and he bled a couple of seasons ago, but he's come back better than ever. His body is coping really well now and he was impressive when winning at Doncaster last month. He wants decent ground and can definitely win again this spring. 13-03-26

runners.comment: Beaten 23l (2m4f) and 13l (2m) in his two handicaps and now goes in a tongue-tie
runners.spotlight: Low mileage for an 8yo; beaten 23l (2m4f) and 13l (2m) in his two handicaps and now goes in a tongue-tie which clearly needs to make some difference.

runners.breeder: S C E A De Maulepaire
runners.comment: A game winner two months ago at this trip and thereabouts off just 4lb higher
runners.spotlight: Game in winning at the eighth attempt at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft; 11-4 favourite) two months ago; subsequent 4lb rise looks fair and cheekpieces go on (has twice worn a hood in the past); should be thereabouts.

quotes.race: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap Hurdle (Go North Cab On Target Series Qualifier)
quotes.quote: Cher Monsieur is still learning his job but he's very tough and genuine. We've got racing turning in and I've winged three out and two out but I got the last wrong. quotes.quote: We're obviously disappointed. Francesi probably should have won a few days ago and then he might not have run here, but that's the luck of the game. We were unlucky to get beat. It would have been nice to break the record, but we gave it a good go. It didn't suit us from the start as we jumped so well and nothing wanted to take us along - that was the first time Aisling Oscar had made the running in his nine runs - Adrian Keatley, trainer.

quotes.race: Win £250,000 With BetMGM's Golden Goals Handicap
quotes.quote: The transformation in Aisling Oscar since we bought him has been amazing. He looks a different horse now and he takes his racing so well. We bought him just to have a bit of fun with on the all-weather, and the Arc bonus initiatives are fantastic. It looked like he won cosily enough so hopefully there might be a bit more to come - Dan Astbury, bloodstock agent.

quotes.race: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap
quotes.quote: I feel like Aisling Oscar has improved, so hopefully he can keep going. I don't know what Adrian [Keatley, trainer] will do now, so we'll leave that down to him, but every time he steps up, he tries his hardest. I've definitely got a strong feeling he'll go close again on his next run - Conor Whiteley, jockey, speaking to Sky Sports Racing.

runners.comment: Poor strike-rate but he has turned in two good efforts from three starts this year
runners.spotlight: Just one win to his name from 16 attempts but he has run well in two of his three starts this year, including C&D; that said, he wouldn't appear to have much in hand of his mark.

runners.comment: Tricky customer on a long losing run; dangerous mark though and Rossa Ryan booked tonight
runners.spotlight: Getting on for two years since he last won but he is operating off a reduced mark these days and he ran well over C&D in both December and January; not the easiest ride and Rossa Ryan replaces a 7lb claimer today; should go well.

quotes.race: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)
quotes.quote: Farasi Lane's homework had been brilliant and he was second here last month, which could be considered a career-best and that's amazing for a 6yo to still be improving. That's probably a career-best again and hopefully it shows what we can do with these older horses. There's a 0-90 on Guineas day I've been thinking about, although he might not get in it now - Jamie Insole, joint-trainer.

runners.comment: Had fine winter but his wins have come at other tracks; e-w shout with B Loughnane booked
runners.spotlight: Sits third, one place behind Aisling Oscar, in the All Weather Horse of the Year standings after his fine winter; yet to win at Wolverhampton but he has run well here; Billy Loughnane takes over tonight; each-way shout.

quotes.race: Win £250,000 With BetMGM's Golden Goals "Hands And Heels" Apprentice Handicap (Part Of RE Series)
quotes.quote: He travelled really well and when I asked Francesi he quickened nicely. I wasn't expecting it, I knew he had a small chance but with it being my first ride I wasn't 100% sure. I started off pony racing and joined Tony's (Carroll) in July. He's a brilliant boss and gives a lot of young riders chances - Myla Coppins, jockey, speaking to Sky Sports Racing.

runners.comment: Five wins this winter, including C&D; not suited by steady tempo at Newcastle on Saturday
runners.spotlight: Another who is enjoying a fine winter, winning for the fifth time when seeing off ten rivals at Southwell last month; steadily-run race no good to him at Newcastle on Saturday and he's capable of bouncing back quickly.

racecards.verdict: This may be fought out by the two oldest runners in the field. Rossa Ryan rides FARASI LANE for the first time and he's preferred.
